📖 Type Guide
Classification rules for each trader type
🦁 Apex Predator
big_bet_rate > 60% · win_rate > 65% · durability > 50

win_rate > 72% · Sharpe* > 3 · PnL Draw < 25%
🧊 Ice Quant

win_rate > 65% · total_pnl > 0
💰 Value Hunter
profit_factor > 2 · total_pnl > 0

big_bet_count > 20 · big_bet_rate > 50%
🌊 Degen

⚡ Flash Trader
durability < 35 · total_pnl > 0
🌱 Newcomer
closed_count < 100
🌀 Drifter
fallback — no dominant pattern
